sloka: तद्वच: पितुरेवाहं सम्मतं धर्मचारिण: ।कर्मणा पालयिष्यामि वनवासेन राघव ॥ २.१०५.४३॥
transliteration: tadvaca: piturevāhaṁ sammataṁ dharmacāriṇa: ।karmaṇā pālayiṣyāmi vanavāsena rāghava ॥ 2.105.43॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I will, therefore, obey the command of our venerable father, the champion of righteousness, by living in the forest.
